rows.note: Use 碟 as the all-purpose word for an individual eating plate or a plateful of food.

example.english: This plate of food smells great.

rows.note: Use 餐具 for dishes and other tableware considered collectively.

example.english: Remember to put the plate and other tableware back in the drawer after eating.
example.traditional: 食完飯記得將餐具放返入櫃桶。
example.jyutping: sik6 jyun4 faan6 gei3 dak1 zoeng1 caan1 geoi6 fong3 faan1 jap6 gwai6 tung2

rows.note: Use 板 for a flat, solid sheet or plate, especially in a material or technical context.

example.english: This metal plate isn't thick enough.
example.jyutping: ni1 faai3 gam1 suk6 baan2 hau5 dou6 m4 gau3
